Properties

Document

Extras

Team colours (for the brands in the rows; Reset = the brand's own colours)

Rows

Enter / ↑ ↓ change row, ← → change column. Flag "auto" uses the driver (or rally) name. Rows 9–10 only appear in the Instagram format. With Two columns all 20 rows are used in both formats, split evenly.

Bulk paste

Picture & text

You can also drop a picture on the preview, and drag the text box around on it. Footer = name or source (the logo replaces it when it's in the footer), footer right = rally or date; leave footer right empty to drop its darker cell. The picture takes the room of any band you turn off. Line breaks in the text are kept; long text shrinks to fit.

Headline

Drag the headline on the preview to move the whole block freely.
Names: flag and brand tiles as in the table rows; leave a name empty to skip it

Stat panel

Hero stat: row 1 Value is the huge number and row 1 Stat the text beside it; put *stars* round words to set them in bold, the rest is in the regular weight. Row 2 Stat is the small line under the number. Drag the block on the preview to move it.
The stats are the rows above (Stat | Value); the highlighted row gets its own colour. Drag the stats or the headline on the preview to place them anywhere (the headline then comes loose from the stats); the sliders do the same. "Automatic" colours follow the style: dark labels and light values for the ladder, white labels and gold numbers for big numbers.

Strips

Drop a picture straight onto a strip in the preview, drag a picture to move it, scroll on it to zoom. Drag a row of chips or a text box to put it anywhere; scroll on a chip row to resize it. A chip can be text, an icon with text, a brand or a flag, in any colour; a brand chip with no text shows the brand name. "Copy chips to other strips" copies this strip's chips (text included) so you only change what differs.

Slides

Background picture across all slides (one wide photo that carries on as you swipe)
Alt+drag on an empty part of the preview slides the background picture; scroll there with Alt to zoom it.
Photo layout (empty frames: drop pictures in)

Add

Selected

YouTube shows thumbnails small, so keep to a few big words with an outline, one face or car, and nothing important in the bottom-right corner (the video length goes there). The cards under the preview show it at feed size. Drop a transparent PNG (a driver or car cut out) and it goes in without a frame; give it an Outline to lift it off the background. Click to select, drag to move (snaps to the edges, middle and other items; Alt places freely), corner squares resize, the round handle rotates. Shift+drag or scroll on a photo moves / zooms it in its frame. Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+D duplicate, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste, arrows nudge. The YouTube 1280×720 export is a PNG when it's under YouTube's 2 MB limit, otherwise a JPEG that fits.
The slides sit side by side as one long picture, so anything over a slide edge carries on onto the next slide; the strip under the preview shows them all. Click to select, drag to move (it snaps to the slide's edges, middle and other items; hold Alt to place freely), drag any corner square to resize, or use Photo size / Width / height (Shift keeps a photo's shape), the round handle to rotate. Shift+drag or scroll on a photo moves / zooms the picture in its frame. Drop pictures on the preview: on a frame they replace its picture, elsewhere they fill this slide's empty frames first. Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+D duplicate, arrows nudge, PageUp/PageDown change slide.

Project

A project file (.wrcproj) holds everything on this graphic: the mode, text, rows, options and its pictures. It saves into the same folder as your PNGs. Opening one puts it back exactly, even on another computer.
